svg.text: Which tree comes next? One plane tree through my thesis

I follow one plane tree that must be replaced on a Porta street through eight stages, and back to the street. The dark lines show what others have done; the pink line is what I add. Cyan stages involve people, amber stages happen in the machine.
Plane trees are replaced one by one · Heat and pluvial runoff both matter in Porta · Species choice rarely uses traits (SylvCiT's runoff module is disabled)
